maintainer_summary: Fixes empty-final-batch crash in DataLoader.__iter__ with a guard; good tests. One logic issue: the original code ignored drop_last entirely, and this PR's handling should be double-checked against the docs. ~5 min human review after.
strengths: Put the fix where the bug actually is (__iter__), not in collate_fn
Three focused tests, including the exact-multiple case that caused the crash
Updated docs in the same PR

coaching.what: Before your change, drop_last was never checked in __iter__, so this changes behavior for drop_last=True users too.
coaching.why: Changing behavior beyond the issue's scope makes maintainers nervous; call it out so they can review it on purpose.
coaching.question: What did a user with drop_last=True get before your change, and is the new behavior what the docs promise?

coaching.what: The test name says what, but not why it matters.
coaching.why: Future contributors will read this test to understand issue #512.
coaching.question: Could a one-line comment link this test to the bug it prevents?

understanding_check: Why does the empty batch happen only when the dataset size is an exact multiple of batch_size?
Why does the fix belong in __iter__ rather than in collate_fn?
